items.title: Fanny: A strong Aspirant spirit becomes the blade that cuts through despair.
items.jp: 強い信念は、絶望を断ち切る刃となる
items.en: A strong Aspirant spirit becomes the blade that cuts through despair.

items.title: Fanny: Off we go, toward a free world!
items.jp: 自由な世界に向かって出発よ
items.en: Off we go, toward a free world!

items.title: Fanny: I'm not working hard just to take first place.
items.jp: 1位を取るために頑張っているわけではないわ
items.en: I'm not working hard just to take first place.

items.title: Fanny: Flying feels great.
items.jp: 飛ぶのは気持ちがいいね
items.en: Flying feels great.

items.title: Fanny: I wish all of this... were just a bad dream.
items.jp: この全てが、ただの悪夢だったらいいのに
items.en: I wish all of this... were just a bad dream.

items.title: Fanny: Flying is banned on school grounds. Yes. But if I only sneak in a little flight...
items.jp: 学校の中は飛行禁止、はい、でも、こっそり飛ぶだけなら
items.en: Flying is banned on school grounds. Yes. But if I only sneak in a little flight...

items.title: Fanny: As humanity's last hope, I can't afford to give up.
items.jp: 人類最後の希望として、諦めるわけにはいかないのだ
items.en: As humanity's last hope, I can't afford to give up.

items.title: Fanny: Someday, the day will come when I can leave Terrinia freely.
items.jp: いつか自由にライトルトを出られる日が来る
items.en: Someday, the day will come when I can leave Terrinia freely.

items.title: Fanny: Training is fun.
items.jp: トレーニングは面白いわよ
items.en: Training is fun.

items.title: Fanny: I wonder if there's another me on the other side of the sky.
items.jp: 空のあっち側に、もう一人の私がいるのかな
items.en: I wonder if there's another me on the other side of the sky.

items.title: Fanny: It's dangerous outside Terrinia, but I'll protect everyone.
items.jp: ライトルトの外は危険だけど、私がみんなを守るわ
items.en: It's dangerous outside Terrinia, but I'll protect everyone.

items.title: Fanny: I'm ready. The test is about to start.
items.jp: 準備はできた、テストが始まるよ
items.en: I'm ready. The test is about to start.

items.title: Fanny: Layla! Let's train together.
items.jp: ライラ、一緒にトレーニングしよう
items.en: Layla! Let's train together.

items.title: Fanny: Protecting Terrinia is our duty.
items.jp: ライトルトを守るのが私たちの責務よ
items.en: Protecting Terrinia is our duty.

items.title: Fanny: You ugly Enders.
items.jp: 醜い破壊者め
items.en: You ugly Enders.

items.title: Fanny: There must be so many interesting things out in the world.
items.jp: 外の世界には、きっと面白いものがいっぱい
items.en: There must be so many interesting things out in the world.

items.title: Fanny: We carry the Aspirant spirit of all humanity.
items.jp: 私たちは、全人類の信念を背負っている
items.en: We carry the Aspirant spirit of all humanity.

items.title: Fanny: I'll show you. I'm going to become the strongest Aspirant.
items.jp: 最強の威力者になってみせるわ
items.en: I'll show you. I'm going to become the strongest Aspirant.

items.title: Fanny: Take this!
items.jp: 食らいなさい
items.en: Take this!

items.title: Fanny: You're not getting away.
items.jp: 逃がさないわ
items.en: You're not getting away.

items.title: Fanny: Victory will surely... come.
items.jp: 勝利はきっと、訪れる
items.en: Victory will surely... come.

items.title: Fanny: Don't give up.
items.jp: 諦めないで
items.en: Don't give up.

items.title: Fanny: Let's do our best together.
items.jp: 一緒に頑張ろう
items.en: Let's do our best together.

items.title: Fanny: Hm? You still want to fight?
items.jp: ん、まだやる気なの
items.en: Hm? You still want to fight?

items.title: Fanny: Do you give up now?
items.jp: これで参った
items.en: Do you give up now?

items.title: Fanny: Do you want to try out this blade?
items.jp: この刀、試してみたいの
items.en: Do you want to try out this blade?

items.title: Fanny: Hm? I feel someone's eyes on me from somewhere...
items.jp: ん、どこからか視線が
items.en: Hm? I feel someone's eyes on me from somewhere...

items.title: Fanny: Who's there?! Phew, you startled me.
items.jp: 誰だ、はあ、びっくりした
items.en: Who's there?! Phew, you startled me.

items.title: Fanny: full compilation
items.note: All 28 lines of Fanny in one recording, in order.

items.title: Layla: I'm going to carry out justice!
items.jp: 正義を執行するわよ
items.en: I'm going to carry out justice!

items.title: Layla: I'm going to take back first place!
items.jp: 1位を奪い返すわよ
items.en: I'm going to take back first place!

items.title: Layla: School rules? What are those?
items.jp: 校則、なにそれ
items.en: School rules? What are those?

items.title: Layla: I'll take down the Enders!
items.jp: 破壊者は私が倒すわ
items.en: I'll take down the Enders!

items.title: Layla: I'm not interested in the outside world. I haven't been sneaking a peek, either.
items.jp: 外の世界に興味なんてないわ、こっそり覗いたりしてないわよ
items.en: I'm not interested in the outside world. I haven't been sneaking a peek, either.

items.title: Layla: In the end, humanity wins. Obviously, right?
items.jp: 最後は人類が勝つ、当たり前でしょ
items.en: In the end, humanity wins. Obviously, right?

items.title: Layla: How do you like my uniform? I customized it myself.
items.jp: 私の制服どう、自分でアレンジしたのよ
items.en: How do you like my uniform? I customized it myself.

items.title: Layla: This is my secret base. Don't tell anyone.
items.jp: ここは私の秘密基地、誰にも言わないでね
items.en: This is my secret base. Don't tell anyone.

items.title: Layla: You can't escape my magic gun!
items.jp: 私のマジックガンからは逃げられないわよ
items.en: You can't escape my magic gun!

items.title: Layla: Shh. I'm lining up my aim. Don't get in my way!
items.jp: しっ、照準を合わせているの、邪魔しないで
items.en: Shh. I'm lining up my aim. Don't get in my way!

items.title: Layla: If you're scared, you can hide behind me.
items.jp: 怖いなら私の後ろに隠れてもいいわよ
items.en: If you're scared, you can hide behind me.

items.title: Layla: Don't worry! There's no way a despicable Ender could hurt me.
items.jp: 安心して、卑劣な破壊者が私を傷つけられるわけないわ
items.en: Don't worry! There's no way a despicable Ender could hurt me.

items.title: Layla: Train together? Sorry, let's do it another time.
items.jp: 一緒にトレーニング、ごめんね、また今度にしましょう
items.en: Train together? Sorry, let's do it another time.

items.title: Layla: It's just a test match! There's no way I'd be nervous.
items.jp: たかがテストマッチよ、私が緊張するわけないじゃない
items.en: It's just a test match! There's no way I'd be nervous.

items.title: Layla: I appreciate the thought, but... I prefer being alone.
items.jp: 気持ちは嬉しいけど、一人の方が好きだわ
items.en: I appreciate the thought, but... I prefer being alone.

items.title: Layla: Is it really that important what people think of me?
items.jp: どう思われているのかって、そんなに大事
items.en: Is it really that important what people think of me?

items.title: Layla: The mission of an Aspirant? Protecting all of humanity, of course!
items.jp: 威力者の使命、全人類を守ることに決まっているでしょ
items.en: The mission of an Aspirant? Protecting all of humanity, of course!

items.title: Layla: The strongest Aspirant is, of course, me!
items.jp: 最強の威力者は、もちろん私よ
items.en: The strongest Aspirant is, of course, me!

items.title: Layla: Fire!
items.jp: 発射
items.en: Fire!

items.title: Layla: Target, locked on!
items.jp: ターゲット、ロックオン
items.en: Target, locked on!

items.title: Layla: Huh...? No way... What...
items.jp: はぁっ、そんな、なっ
items.en: Huh...? No way... What...

items.title: Layla: Why...
items.jp: どうして
items.en: Why...

items.title: Layla: Well, I'll admit you've got skill.
items.jp: まあ、あんたの実力は認めるわよ
items.en: Well, I'll admit you've got skill.

items.title: Layla: Want to try another match?
items.jp: もう一回勝負してみる
items.en: Want to try another match?

items.title: Layla: I really am the strongest!
items.jp: 私こそが最強ね
items.en: I really am the strongest!

items.title: Layla: I said go away!
items.jp: あっち行ってってば
items.en: I said go away!

items.title: Layla: Hm? What are you doing?
items.jp: ん、何を
items.en: Hm? What are you doing?

items.title: Layla: Don't touch me so casually!
items.jp: 軽々しく触らないで
items.en: Don't touch me so casually!

items.title: Layla: full compilation
items.note: All 28 lines of Layla in one recording, in order.

items.title: Ruby: I'm never letting go of you!
items.jp: 離さないんだから
items.en: I'm never letting go of you!

items.title: Ruby: Stop it! Do you want to get hurt? Heh.
items.jp: やめっ、痛い目に遭いたいの、ふっ
items.en: Stop it! Do you want to get hurt? Heh.

items.title: Ruby: Okay, nobody's around. Hehe... oh! ...Ahem.
items.jp: よし、誰もいない、ふふふ、あっ、うんうん
items.en: Okay, nobody's around. Hehe... oh! ...Ahem.

items.title: Ruby: Huh...? What happened? Found it!
items.jp: えっ、何が起きたの、あった
items.en: Huh...? What happened? Found it!

items.title: Ruby: Freedom! Hahaha!
items.jp: 自由だ、あははは
items.en: Freedom! Hahaha!

items.title: Ruby: Into the world of programming!
items.jp: プログラミングの世界へ
items.en: Into the world of programming!

items.title: Ruby: A perfect update!
items.jp: 完璧なアップデート
items.en: A perfect update!

items.title: Ruby: Starting the retest!
items.jp: 再テスト開始
items.en: Starting the retest!

items.title: Ruby: I'll be right back.
items.jp: すぐ戻るからね
items.en: I'll be right back.

items.title: Ruby: Unknown error.
items.jp: 原因不明エラー
items.en: Unknown error.

items.title: Ruby: How's that? Look at this.
items.jp: どう、これ見て
items.en: How's that? Look at this.

items.title: Ruby: Nice.
items.jp: いいねぇ
items.en: Nice.

items.title: Ruby: Obstacle removal complete.
items.jp: 障害の排除完了
items.en: Obstacle removal complete.

items.title: Ruby: I'm good at troubleshooting, you know.
items.jp: トラブルシューティングは得意なのよね
items.en: I'm good at troubleshooting, you know.

items.title: Ruby: The dawn is finally coming.
items.jp: ついに夜明けがやってくる
items.en: The dawn is finally coming.

items.title: Ruby: I'm not bound by any rules.
items.jp: 私はどんなルールにも縛られない
items.en: I'm not bound by any rules.

items.title: Ruby: Heh. No one can get in the way of my freedom.
items.jp: ふふん、誰も私の自由は邪魔できない
items.en: Heh. No one can get in the way of my freedom.

items.title: Ruby: What I'm supposed to do, I'll see through to the end, responsibly.
items.jp: 自分がやるべきことは、責任を持って最後までやるよ
items.en: What I'm supposed to do, I'll see through to the end, responsibly.

items.title: Ruby: No... I'm not anyone's puppet.
items.jp: 違う、私は誰かの操り人形じゃない
items.en: No... I'm not anyone's puppet.

items.title: Ruby: If you disguise yourself for long enough, you lose sight of who you really are.
items.jp: 長い間自分を偽っていると、本当の自分を見失うものよ
items.en: If you disguise yourself for long enough, you lose sight of who you really are.

items.title: Ruby: She and I are different. Nothing alike.
items.jp: あの子と私は違う、似ても似つかない
items.en: She and I are different. Nothing alike.

items.title: Ruby: Mmm, I can't hold it back any longer.
items.jp: うーん、もうこれ以上我慢できない
items.en: Mmm, I can't hold it back any longer.

items.title: Ruby: Whichever road I take, I won't give up my freedom.
items.jp: どの道を行こうとも、自由を諦めるつもりはないよ
items.en: Whichever road I take, I won't give up my freedom.

items.title: Ruby: To me, home is like a golden birdcage.
items.jp: 私にとって家は、金の鳥かごみたいなもの
items.en: To me, home is like a golden birdcage.

items.title: Ruby: Come here!
items.jp: 来い
items.en: Come here!

items.title: Ruby: Disappear!
items.jp: 消えちゃえ
items.en: Disappear!

items.title: Ruby: How about this?
items.jp: これはどう
items.en: How about this?

items.title: Ruby: Don't get in my way!
items.jp: 邪魔しないで
items.en: Don't get in my way!

items.title: Ruby: Weak, weak.
items.jp: 弱い弱い
items.en: Weak, weak.

items.title: Ruby: Take this!
items.jp: くらえ
items.en: Take this!

items.title: Ruby: Let's dance!
items.jp: 踊りましょう
items.en: Let's dance!

items.title: Ruby: You want to take me on?
items.jp: 私とやるの
items.en: You want to take me on?

items.title: Ruby: Not that way.
items.jp: そっちじゃないよ
items.en: Not that way.

items.title: Ruby: Just... a little more...
items.jp: あと、少しなのに
items.en: Just... a little more...

items.title: Ruby: That's only to be expected.
items.jp: 当然の結果ね
items.en: That's only to be expected.

items.title: Ruby: Is that all?
items.jp: それで終わりなの
items.en: Is that all?

items.title: Ruby: You brought it on yourselves.
items.jp: 自業自得ね
items.en: You brought it on yourselves.

items.title: Ruby: You're the one who controls yourself. What to do is yours to decide.
items.jp: 自分を操るのは自分、どうするかは、自分で決めていいの
items.en: You're the one who controls yourself. What to do is yours to decide.

items.title: Ruby: Now you're free. Forever.
items.jp: これで自由ね、永遠に
items.en: Now you're free. Forever.

items.title: Ruby: Let's go home.
items.jp: お家に帰りましょう
items.en: Let's go home.

items.title: Ruby: full compilation
items.note: All 40 lines of Ruby in one recording, in order.

items.title: Angela: Um, please wait just a moment. Ah... haha.
items.jp: うん、ちょっと待ってくださいね、ああ、あはは
items.en: Um, please wait just a moment. Ah... haha.

items.title: Angela: It's all right, Tetra.
items.jp: 大丈夫ですよ、テトラ
items.en: It's all right, Tetra.

items.title: Angela: Say cheese! Ahahaha!
items.jp: はい、チーズ、あはははは
items.en: Say cheese! Ahahaha!

items.title: Angela: Hm? Huh? Ahaha.
items.jp: ん、え、あはは
items.en: Hm? Huh? Ahaha.

items.title: Angela: Will a dawn come for me, too?
items.jp: 私にも夜明けがやってくるのでしょうか
items.en: Will a dawn come for me, too?

items.title: Angela: I want to protect everyone!
items.jp: 私はみんなを守りたい
items.en: I want to protect everyone!

items.title: Angela: Phew... error repair complete!
items.jp: はぁ、エラー修復完了
items.en: Phew... error repair complete!

items.title: Angela: Reboot successful!
items.jp: 再起動成功
items.en: Reboot successful!

items.title: Angela: Battery recharged!
items.jp: バッテリー補充
items.en: Battery recharged!

items.title: Angela: I'm going back home.
items.jp: お家に帰ります
items.en: I'm going back home.

items.title: Angela: It's a new module, isn't it?
items.jp: 新しいモジュールですね
items.en: It's a new module, isn't it?

items.title: Angela: Oh... thank you very much.
items.jp: あっ、ありがとうございます
items.en: Oh... thank you very much.

items.title: Angela: I won't let anyone hurt my friends!
items.jp: 私の仲間は傷つけさせません
items.en: I won't let anyone hurt my friends!

items.title: Angela: I thought Lord was a good person.
items.jp: ルオードっていい人だと思っていました
items.en: I thought Lord was a good person.

items.title: Angela: My heart keeps running even without beating, but it feels strange.
items.jp: 私の心臓は鼓動しなくても稼働しますが、違和感がありますね
items.en: My heart keeps running even without beating, but it feels strange.

items.title: Angela: This form... I wonder if everyone will accept me.
items.jp: この姿、みんなに受け入れてもらえるでしょうか
items.en: This form... I wonder if everyone will accept me.

items.title: Angela: Tetra, do you understand the emotion called loneliness?
items.jp: テトラ、孤独という感情、わかりますか
items.en: Tetra, do you understand the emotion called loneliness?

items.title: Angela: I feel warmth. But why? There's no reaction at all in my cooling system.
items.jp: 暖かさを感じます、でも、どうしてでしょう、冷却システムには何の反応もありません
items.en: I feel warmth. But why? There's no reaction at all in my cooling system.

items.title: Angela: Click, click, click. Can you hear the sound of my heart?
items.jp: カチ、カチ、カチ、私の心臓の音、聞こえますか
items.en: Click, click, click. Can you hear the sound of my heart?

items.title: Angela: This world is overflowing with things I want to learn.
items.jp: この世界は学びたいことで溢れています
items.en: This world is overflowing with things I want to learn.

items.title: Angela: Tetra, even if I stop moving, will you stay with me?
items.jp: テトラ、私が動かなくなっても、一緒にいてくれますか
items.en: Tetra, even if I stop moving, will you stay with me?

items.title: Angela: I must be careful not to stray too far from everyone.
items.jp: みんなから、あまり離れすぎないようにしなきゃ
items.en: I must be careful not to stray too far from everyone.

items.title: Angela: Whenever I think about the friends I lost, a malfunction always occurs. But I don't want to fix this.
items.jp: 失くした仲間のことを考えると、いつも誤作動が発生します、でもこれは直したくありません
items.en: Whenever I think about the friends I lost, a malfunction always occurs. But I don't want to fix this.

items.title: Angela: The dawn will surely come, so there's nothing to worry about!
items.jp: 夜明けが必ずやってくるから、心配なことなんてありません
items.en: The dawn will surely come, so there's nothing to worry about!

items.title: Angela: Leave it to me!
items.jp: 私に任せてください
items.en: Leave it to me!

items.title: Angela: I'm sorry if that hurt.
items.jp: 痛かったらごめんなさい
items.en: I'm sorry if that hurt.

items.title: Angela: You're safe now.
items.jp: もう大丈夫ですよ
items.en: You're safe now.

items.title: Angela: Let's go, Tetra!
items.jp: 行きましょう、テトラ
items.en: Let's go, Tetra!

items.title: Angela: Are you all right?
items.jp: 大丈夫ですか
items.en: Are you all right?

items.title: Angela: I'll do my best, too!
items.jp: 私も頑張ります
items.en: I'll do my best, too!

items.title: Angela: Analyzing behavior.
items.jp: 行動分析中
items.en: Analyzing behavior.

items.title: Angela: I'm right here beside you!
items.jp: 私がそばにいますよ
items.en: I'm right here beside you!

items.title: Angela: Deploying shield!
items.jp: シールド展開
items.en: Deploying shield!

items.title: Angela: The warmth... is disappearing...
items.jp: 暖かさが、なくなる
items.en: The warmth... is disappearing...

items.title: Angela: Did I end up hurting someone?
items.jp: 傷つけてしまいましたか
items.en: Did I end up hurting someone?

items.title: Angela: I don't want to do things like this.
items.jp: こういうことはしたくありません
items.en: I don't want to do things like this.

items.title: Angela: Is this the end?
items.jp: これで終わりですか
items.en: Is this the end?

items.title: Angela: Do you intend to take me back with you?
items.jp: 私を連れて帰るつもりですか
items.en: Do you intend to take me back with you?

items.title: Angela: Let's go anywhere together.
items.jp: 一緒にどこへでも行きましょう
items.en: Let's go anywhere together.

items.title: Angela: How can I fly even without wings?
items.jp: どうすれば羽がなくても飛べますか
items.en: How can I fly even without wings?

items.title: Angela: full compilation
items.note: All 40 lines of Angela in one recording, in order.

items.title: Lesley: Bullets are the only language the enemy understands.
items.jp: 弾丸が、敵に通じる唯一の言葉
items.en: Bullets are the only language the enemy understands.

items.title: Lesley: Victory is certain to await the future of this world.
items.jp: この世界の未来には、必ず勝利が待っている
items.en: Victory is certain to await the future of this world.

items.title: Lesley: There's no time to lament.
items.jp: 嘆いている暇はない
items.en: There's no time to lament.

items.title: Lesley: As long as we have heart, we will never surrender.
items.jp: 心がある限り、決して降伏しない
items.en: As long as we have heart, we will never surrender.

items.title: Lesley: Knowing when to retreat is an important skill, too.
items.jp: 撤退の頃合いを見極めるのも、重要な技術よ
items.en: Knowing when to retreat is an important skill, too.

items.title: Lesley: Don't stray from the Aspirant light.
items.jp: 信念の光から離れないで
items.en: Don't stray from the Aspirant light.

items.title: Lesley: Now victory is certain.
items.jp: これで勝利は確実ね
items.en: Now victory is certain.

items.title: Lesley: A new product from R&D?
items.jp: 研究開発部の新作
items.en: A new product from R&D?

items.title: Lesley: Another threat eliminated.
items.jp: また一つ、脅威を排除した
items.en: Another threat eliminated.

items.title: Lesley: Your complacency led you to your ruin.
items.jp: 慢心があなたを破滅へと導いたのよ
items.en: Your complacency led you to your ruin.

items.title: Lesley: Distance is just a number. There's no target beyond my reach.
items.jp: 距離は単なる数字、私に届かない標的はないわ
items.en: Distance is just a number. There's no target beyond my reach.

items.title: Lesley: Not a single enemy will escape.
items.jp: 敵は一匹たりとも逃さない
items.en: Not a single enemy will escape.

items.title: Lesley: With the bullet of hope, I'll shatter your rotten ambitions.
items.jp: 希望の弾丸で、腐った野望を打ち砕く
items.en: With the bullet of hope, I'll shatter your rotten ambitions.

items.title: Lesley: Focus. Make your mind and body one with your Aspirant spirit.
items.jp: 集中して、あなたの心と体を、信念と一つに
items.en: Focus. Make your mind and body one with your Aspirant spirit.

items.title: Lesley: We still don't fully understand our own power. But by trusting each other, we can gain limitless strength.
items.jp: 私たちはまだ、自分たちの力を完全には理解していない、でも、互いを信じることで無限の力を得られる
items.en: We still don't fully understand our own power. But by trusting each other, we can gain limitless strength.

items.title: Lesley: Instructors shouldn't only teach technique, they should also teach a loving heart, perseverance, and the Aspirant spirit.
items.jp: 教官は技術を教えるだけでなく、愛する心や耐え抜くこと、信念も教えるべきよ
items.en: Instructors shouldn't only teach technique, they should also teach a loving heart, perseverance, and the Aspirant spirit.

items.title: Lesley: Only with the Aspirant spirit can you gain strength.
items.jp: 信念があればこそ、力も身につく
items.en: Only with the Aspirant spirit can you gain strength.

items.title: Lesley: With this bullet, I'll shoot through evil and open the way.
items.jp: この弾丸で悪を撃ち抜き、道を開く
items.en: With this bullet, I'll shoot through evil and open the way.

items.title: Lesley: I fight for freedom.
items.jp: 自由のために戦う
items.en: I fight for freedom.

items.title: Lesley: One without the Aspirant spirit is like a gun without bullets.
items.jp: 信念のない者は、弾丸のない銃のようなもの
items.en: One without the Aspirant spirit is like a gun without bullets.

items.title: Lesley: I always hit my target.
items.jp: 標的は必ず撃ち抜く
items.en: I always hit my target.

items.title: Lesley: Too slow.
items.jp: 遅すぎる
items.en: Too slow.

items.title: Lesley: This battle, I'm in control.
items.jp: この戦い、私が支配する
items.en: This battle, I'm in control.

items.title: Lesley: Focus on the fight.
items.jp: 戦いに集中しなさい
items.en: Focus on the fight.

items.title: Lesley: One shot, that's enough.
items.jp: 一発、それで十分
items.en: One shot, that's enough.

items.title: Lesley: I'll hit you!
items.jp: 当てる
items.en: I'll hit you!

items.title: Lesley: This is my Aspirant power.
items.jp: これが私の信念の力
items.en: This is my Aspirant power.

items.title: Lesley: Switching to stealth mode.
items.jp: ステルスモードに移行する
items.en: Switching to stealth mode.

items.title: Lesley: Repulsor!
items.jp: リパルサー
items.en: Repulsor!

items.title: Lesley: I'll end it here.
items.jp: これで終わらせる
items.en: I'll end it here.

items.title: Lesley: Locked on!
items.jp: ロックオン
items.en: Locked on!

items.title: Lesley: Take this as a lesson.
items.jp: これを教訓にすることね
items.en: Take this as a lesson.

items.title: Lesley: If only you'd had a proper instructor...
items.jp: あなたにまともな教官がいたら
items.en: If only you'd had a proper instructor...

items.title: Lesley: There was no other road for you than this.
items.jp: こうなる道しかなかったのよ
items.en: There was no other road for you than this.

items.title: Lesley: There's still... hope... ah.
items.jp: まだ、希望、あっ
items.en: There's still... hope... ah.

items.title: Lesley: Chang'e, ever since that day, I vowed to protect you.
items.jp: ジョーカー、あの日以来、私はあなたを守ると誓った
items.en: Chang'e, ever since that day, I vowed to protect you.
items.note: The file name reads ジョーカー (Joker), a transcript error. The line is addressed to Chang'e (嫦娥).

items.title: Lesley: Don't make me do this. Chang'e...
items.jp: 私にこんなことをさせないで、ジョーカー
items.en: Don't make me do this. Chang'e...
items.note: The file name reads ジョーカー (Joker), a transcript error. The line is addressed to Chang'e (嫦娥).

items.title: Lesley: full compilation
items.note: All 37 lines of Lesley in one recording, in order.

items.title: Chang'e: This little scientist will protect the world!
items.jp: 小さな科学者が、世界を守るよ
items.en: This little scientist will protect the world!

items.title: Chang'e: Here we go! Mr. Bunny!
items.jp: いくよ、ウサギさん
items.en: Here we go! Mr. Bunny!

items.title: Chang'e: I'm telling Big Sis on you!
items.jp: お姉ちゃんに言いつけてやる
items.en: I'm telling Big Sis on you!

items.title: Chang'e: Please, just pretend you didn't see anything.
items.jp: ください、見なかったことにして
items.en: Please, just pretend you didn't see anything.

items.title: Chang'e: Off on another journey in search of endless ideas.
items.jp: 無限のアイデアを求めて、また旅に出るよ
items.en: Off on another journey in search of endless ideas.

items.title: Chang'e: Crescent Moon, going once more!
items.jp: 三日月、もう一度行きまーす
items.en: Crescent Moon, going once more!

items.title: Chang'e: I want new gadgets!
items.jp: 新しいガジェット、欲しい
items.en: I want new gadgets!

items.title: Chang'e: Look! Mr. Bunny, it's a new friend for you.
items.jp: ほら、ウサギさん、新しいお友達だよ
items.en: Look! Mr. Bunny, it's a new friend for you.

items.title: Chang'e: Big Sis always used to say I wasn't training enough.
items.jp: 訓練が足りないって、お姉ちゃんがよく言ってたよ
items.en: Big Sis always used to say I wasn't training enough.

items.title: Chang'e: Wow, that was half-baked.
items.jp: わあ、中途半端だったな
items.en: Wow, that was half-baked.

items.title: Chang'e: With Mr. Bunny and me, even 1 plus 1 is bigger than 2.
items.jp: ウサギさんと私なら、1足す1でも2より大きくなるよ
items.en: With Mr. Bunny and me, even 1 plus 1 is bigger than 2.

items.title: Chang'e: I'm already a grown-up. Don't treat me like a kid.
items.jp: 私はもう大人だよ、子供扱いしないで
items.en: I'm already a grown-up. Don't treat me like a kid.

items.title: Chang'e: Big Sis said imagination is my weapon.
items.jp: お姉ちゃんが、想像力が私の武器って言ってた
items.en: Big Sis said imagination is my weapon.

items.title: Chang'e: Mr. Bunny is my best friend. I won't let anyone take him away.
items.jp: ウサギさんは私の親友だもん、誰にも奪わせないよ
items.en: Mr. Bunny is my best friend. I won't let anyone take him away.

items.title: Chang'e: Hearts that believe in each other become our strength.
items.jp: お互いを信じる心が、私たちの力になるの
items.en: Hearts that believe in each other become our strength.

items.title: Chang'e: I won't forgive anyone who tries to destroy the world.
items.jp: 世界を壊そうとする人は、許さないよ
items.en: I won't forgive anyone who tries to destroy the world.

items.title: Chang'e: The Aspirant power? That's me!
items.jp: 信念の力、それは私
items.en: The Aspirant power? That's me!

items.title: Chang'e: When an idea comes to me, I go straight back to the lab.
items.jp: アイデアが浮かんだら、すぐ研究室に戻るんだ
items.en: When an idea comes to me, I go straight back to the lab.

items.title: Chang'e: Being weak can't be helped, but not being smart... well.
items.jp: 弱いのは仕方ないけど、賢くないのはねー
items.en: Being weak can't be helped, but not being smart... well.

items.title: Chang'e: I can't keep hiding in Big Sis's shadow. I'll fight and grow, too.
items.jp: お姉ちゃんの陰にばっかり隠れていられない、私も戦って成長する
items.en: I can't keep hiding in Big Sis's shadow. I'll fight and grow, too.

items.title: Chang'e: Mr. Bunny, together!
items.jp: ウサギさん、一緒に
items.en: Mr. Bunny, together!

items.title: Chang'e: Console! Activate!
items.jp: コンソール、起動
items.en: Console! Activate!

items.title: Chang'e: I'll protect everyone's Aspirant spirit!
items.jp: みんなの信念は、私が守る
items.en: I'll protect everyone's Aspirant spirit!

items.title: Chang'e: The Aspirant power is strong.
items.jp: 信念の力は強いんだよ
items.en: The Aspirant power is strong.

items.title: Chang'e: Don't bully Mr. Bunny!
items.jp: ウサギさんをいじめないで
items.en: Don't bully Mr. Bunny!

items.title: Chang'e: I'll show you my power.
items.jp: 私の力、見せてあげる
items.en: I'll show you my power.

items.title: Chang'e: I'll definitely protect everyone!
items.jp: 必ずみんなを守る
items.en: I'll definitely protect everyone!

items.title: Chang'e: Take this!
items.jp: くらえー
items.en: Take this!

items.title: Chang'e: Aspirant power, guide me.
items.jp: 信念の力、導いて
items.en: Aspirant power, guide me.

items.title: Chang'e: Straight ahead! Maximum output!
items.jp: 前方に、出力最大
items.en: Straight ahead! Maximum output!

items.title: Chang'e: This is the power of my super-genius invention!
items.jp: 私の超天才的発明の力よ
items.en: This is the power of my super-genius invention!

items.title: Chang'e: What a weird way to sleep.
items.jp: 変な寝方だね
items.en: What a weird way to sleep.

items.title: Chang'e: I told you I'm not a kid.
items.jp: 子供じゃないって言ったでしょ
items.en: I told you I'm not a kid.

items.title: Chang'e: Phew, all done.
items.jp: はぁ、終わった
items.en: Phew, all done.

items.title: Chang'e: Big Sis, Mr. Bunny says he was lonely.
items.jp: お姉ちゃん、ウサギさんが寂しかったって
items.en: Big Sis, Mr. Bunny says he was lonely.

items.title: Chang'e: I hate scary Big Sis!
items.jp: 怖いお姉ちゃんだって大嫌い
items.en: I hate scary Big Sis!

items.title: Chang'e: I can't... believe it.
items.jp: 信じ、られない
items.en: I can't... believe it.

items.title: Chang'e: full compilation
items.note: All 37 lines of Chang'e in one recording, in order.

items.title: Guinevere: I will become a star shining in broad daylight and guide her.
items.jp: 私は白昼に輝く星となり、彼女を導く
items.en: I will become a star shining in broad daylight and guide her.

items.title: Guinevere: This destiny is something the two of us should bear together.
items.jp: この運命は、二人で背負うべきよ
items.en: This destiny is something the two of us should bear together.

items.title: Guinevere: The Aspirant light will never go out.
items.jp: 信念の光は、決して消えない
items.en: The Aspirant light will never go out.

items.title: Guinevere: No matter how many times we start over, our fate won't change.
items.jp: 何度やり直しても、私たちの運命は変わらない
items.en: No matter how many times we start over, our fate won't change.

items.title: Guinevere: I'm looking forward to our reunion at dawn.
items.jp: 夜明けの再会を楽しみにしているわ
items.en: I'm looking forward to our reunion at dawn.

items.title: Guinevere: I won't stop. I still have something to protect.
items.jp: 私は止まらない、まだ守るべきものがあるから
items.en: I won't stop. I still have something to protect.

items.title: Guinevere: I wonder if this would suit Vexana, too.
items.jp: サナにも似合うかしら
items.en: I wonder if this would suit Vexana, too.

items.title: Guinevere: With this power, stronger still.
items.jp: この力で、もっと強く
items.en: With this power, stronger still.

items.title: Guinevere: For the day we can fight together again.
items.jp: また一緒に戦える日を
items.en: For the day we can fight together again.

items.title: Guinevere: Let's go together, to find her.
items.jp: 共に行こう、彼女を見つけるために
items.en: Let's go together, to find her.

items.title: Guinevere: O dark night, do you, too, long for starlight?
items.jp: 闇夜よ、あなたも星の光を求めているの
items.en: O dark night, do you, too, long for starlight?

items.title: Guinevere: We will decide the fate of the world ourselves.
items.jp: 世界の運命は、私たちが決める
items.en: We will decide the fate of the world ourselves.

items.title: Guinevere: Rather than being protected, I choose to fight alongside you.
items.jp: 守られるよりも、一緒に戦うことを選ぶわ
items.en: Rather than being protected, I choose to fight alongside you.

items.title: Guinevere: The Aspirant spirit never lies.
items.jp: 信念は、決して嘘をつかない
items.en: The Aspirant spirit never lies.

items.title: Guinevere: Without her, even the midday sun would freeze.
items.jp: 彼女がいなければ、昼の太陽も凍えてしまう
items.en: Without her, even the midday sun would freeze.

items.title: Guinevere: I am the herald of dawn, and the one who lights starlight in the dark of night.
items.jp: 私は黎明の使者、そして闇夜に星の光を灯すもの
items.en: I am the herald of dawn, and the one who lights starlight in the dark of night.

items.title: Guinevere: Until dawn arrives, I will never let go of your hand.
items.jp: 夜明けが訪れるまで、私は決して手を離さない
items.en: Until dawn arrives, I will never let go of your hand.

items.title: Guinevere: A girl's Aspirant spirit: it is believing in miracles.
items.jp: 少女の信念、それは奇跡を信じること
items.en: A girl's Aspirant spirit: it is believing in miracles.

items.title: Guinevere: You said it, didn't you, that miracles bloom in the darkness of despair.
items.jp: 言ってたよね、奇跡は絶望の闇に咲くものだと
items.en: You said it, didn't you, that miracles bloom in the darkness of despair.

items.title: Guinevere: That radiance is the heartbeat of the Aspirant spirit.
items.jp: あの輝きこそ、信念の鼓動
items.en: That radiance is the heartbeat of the Aspirant spirit.

items.title: Guinevere: This strike is for Vexana.
items.jp: この一撃、サナのために
items.en: This strike is for Vexana.

items.title: Guinevere: We have only one Aspirant spirit.
items.jp: 私たちの信念は、ただ一つ
items.en: We have only one Aspirant spirit.

items.title: Guinevere: Believe in the future.
items.jp: 未来を信じて
items.en: Believe in the future.

items.title: Guinevere: As long as I have the Aspirant spirit, I won't give up.
items.jp: 信念がある限り、私は諦めない
items.en: As long as I have the Aspirant spirit, I won't give up.

items.title: Guinevere: Prepare yourself.
items.jp: 覚悟しなさい
items.en: Prepare yourself.

items.title: Guinevere: The brilliance of the stars never fades.
items.jp: 星の輝きは、決して途絶えない
items.en: The brilliance of the stars never fades.

items.title: Guinevere: I will find her, no matter what.
items.jp: 必ず、彼女を見つけ出す
items.en: I will find her, no matter what.

items.title: Guinevere: Light of the stars, tear through the darkness.
items.jp: 星の光よ、闇を裂け
items.en: Light of the stars, tear through the darkness.

items.title: Guinevere: Light of day, pour down.
items.jp: 白昼の光よ、降り注げ
items.en: Light of day, pour down.

items.title: Guinevere: In the name of Aspirant.
items.jp: 信念の名のもとに
items.en: In the name of Aspirant.
items.note: This line is also in Vexana's list, with the same Japanese and the same file name.

items.title: Guinevere: I'll fight to the very end.
items.jp: 最後まで戦い抜く
items.en: I'll fight to the very end.
items.note: This line is also in Vexana's list, with the same Japanese and the same file name.

items.title: Guinevere: Vexana... to the future where you are.
items.jp: サナ、あなたのいる未来へ
items.en: Vexana... to the future where you are.

items.title: Guinevere: I'm not afraid of the dark.
items.jp: 闇なんて、怖くない
items.en: I'm not afraid of the dark.

items.title: Guinevere: A miracle, with my own hands.
items.jp: 奇跡をこの手で
items.en: A miracle, with my own hands.

items.title: Guinevere: Accept the light of dawn.
items.jp: 黎明の光を受け入れて
items.en: Accept the light of dawn.

items.title: Guinevere: It's not only shooting stars that shine. Vexana, your smile does too.
items.jp: 輝かしいのは流れ星だけじゃない、サナ、あなたの笑顔もよ
items.en: It's not only shooting stars that shine. Vexana, your smile does too.

items.title: Guinevere: Let's settle this with a match, Vexana.
items.jp: 勝負で答えを出しましょう、サナ
items.en: Let's settle this with a match, Vexana.

items.title: Guinevere: Ngh... this is a lady's refinement. It's the way to regain your elegance in three seconds.
items.jp: ぐっ、これはレディのたしなみよ、3秒で優雅さを取り戻す方法なんだから
items.en: Ngh... this is a lady's refinement. It's the way to regain your elegance in three seconds.

items.title: Guinevere: Nothing can resist a strawberry-jam doughnut. Even robots are the same.
items.jp: いちごジャムのドーナツに抗えるものなんていないわ、ロボットだって同じよ
items.en: Nothing can resist a strawberry-jam doughnut. Even robots are the same.

items.title: Guinevere: Planning to run? Hehe, yes, I'm good at catching fast runners.
items.jp: 逃げるつもり、えへへ、はい、私、逃げ足の早いやつを捕まえるのが得意なのよ
items.en: Planning to run? Hehe, yes, I'm good at catching fast runners.

items.title: Guinevere: Training starts tomorrow. No excuses.
items.jp: 明日から特訓よ、言い訳禁止
items.en: Training starts tomorrow. No excuses.

items.title: Guinevere: full compilation
items.note: All 41 lines of Guinevere in one recording, in order.

items.title: Vexana: I will become the sun that lights the dark night, and protect her.
items.jp: 私は闇夜を照らす太陽となり、彼女を守る
items.en: I will become the sun that lights the dark night, and protect her.

items.title: Vexana: This destiny is mine to bear.
items.jp: この運命は、私が背負う
items.en: This destiny is mine to bear.

items.title: Vexana: As long as she is here, my Aspirant spirit will not fade.
items.jp: 彼女がいる限り、信念は消えない
items.en: As long as she is here, my Aspirant spirit will not fade.

items.title: Vexana: If we could start over, would she waver?
items.jp: もしやり直せるなら、彼女は迷うだろうか
items.en: If we could start over, would she waver?

items.title: Vexana: Even hidden in the dark of night, I will remain an unwavering guardian.
items.jp: 闇夜に身を隠そうとも、私は揺るがぬ守護者であり続ける
items.en: Even hidden in the dark of night, I will remain an unwavering guardian.

items.title: Vexana: Just for this moment: time, stop!
items.jp: この瞬間だけ、時よ、止まれ
items.en: Just for this moment: time, stop!

items.title: Vexana: I wonder if Guinevere would like this too.
items.jp: グネビアも気に入るかしら
items.en: I wonder if Guinevere would like this too.

items.title: Vexana: Strengthen this resolve even further.
items.jp: この意志を、さらに強く
items.en: Strengthen this resolve even further.

items.title: Vexana: This is the final farewell.
items.jp: これが最後の別れだ
items.en: This is the final farewell.

items.title: Vexana: Let us go together, to protect her.
items.jp: 共に行こう、彼女を守るために
items.en: Let us go together, to protect her.

items.title: Vexana: Solitude was my fate, so I believed. Until starlight pierced the darkness.
items.jp: 孤独こそが私の宿命、そう信じていた、星の光が闇を裂くまでは
items.en: Solitude was my fate, so I believed. Until starlight pierced the darkness.

items.title: Vexana: This battle will decide the fate of the world.
items.jp: この戦いが、世界の運命を決める
items.en: This battle will decide the fate of the world.

items.title: Vexana: Even if I make an enemy of the world, I will protect her forever.
items.jp: たとえ世界を敵に回しても、私は永遠に彼女を守る
items.en: Even if I make an enemy of the world, I will protect her forever.

items.title: Vexana: For the sake of the Aspirant spirit, I will lie.
items.jp: 信念のために、私は嘘をつく
items.en: For the sake of the Aspirant spirit, I will lie.

items.title: Vexana: Without her, even the stars of the night sky lose their shine.
items.jp: 彼女がいなければ、夜空の星も輝きを失う
items.en: Without her, even the stars of the night sky lose their shine.

items.title: Vexana: I am the herald of the dark night, and the one who awakens the dawn.
items.jp: 私は闇夜の使者、そして黎明を呼び覚ます者
items.en: I am the herald of the dark night, and the one who awakens the dawn.

items.title: Vexana: If night is fated to swallow day, I will vanish before the dawn.
items.jp: もし夜が昼を飲み込む運命ならば、私は黎明の前に消えよう
items.en: If night is fated to swallow day, I will vanish before the dawn.

items.title: Vexana: Even on starless nights, the Aspirant emblem guides me.
items.jp: 星無き夜にも、信念の紋章が私を導いてくれる
items.en: Even on starless nights, the Aspirant emblem guides me.

items.title: Vexana: The will of the stars has spoken: this world will one day meet its end.
items.jp: 星の意志は告げた、この世界はいずれ終焉を迎えると
items.en: The will of the stars has spoken: this world will one day meet its end.

items.title: Vexana: Look up. The stars are shining.
items.jp: 見上げてごらん、星々が輝いてる
items.en: Look up. The stars are shining.

items.title: Vexana: This strike is for Guinevere!
items.jp: この一撃、グネビアのために
items.en: This strike is for Guinevere!

items.title: Vexana: Now is the time. Stake everything.
items.jp: 今こそ、全てをかけて
items.en: Now is the time. Stake everything.

items.title: Vexana: The end is drawing near.
items.jp: 終焉が迫ってる
items.en: The end is drawing near.

items.title: Vexana: As long as I'm here, the Aspirant spirit will not fade.
items.jp: 私がいる限り、信念は消えない
items.en: As long as I'm here, the Aspirant spirit will not fade.

items.title: Vexana: I'll end it here!
items.jp: ここで終わらせる
items.en: I'll end it here!

items.title: Vexana: The crown of the sun will never be extinguished!
items.jp: 太陽の冠は、決して消えない
items.en: The crown of the sun will never be extinguished!

items.title: Vexana: This is a destiny I must bear.
items.jp: これは、私が背負うべき宿命
items.en: This is a destiny I must bear.

items.title: Vexana: An omen of death!
items.jp: 死の兆し
items.en: An omen of death!

items.title: Vexana: Dark night, swallow all things.
items.jp: 暗き夜よ、万物を飲み込め
items.en: Dark night, swallow all things.

items.title: Vexana: In the name of Aspirant.
items.jp: 信念の名のもとに
items.en: In the name of Aspirant.
items.note: This line is also in Guinevere's list, with the same Japanese and the same file name.

items.title: Vexana: I'll fight to the very end.
items.jp: 最後まで戦い抜く
items.en: I'll fight to the very end.
items.note: This line is also in Guinevere's list, with the same Japanese and the same file name.

items.title: Vexana: Guinevere... to the future where you are.
items.jp: グネビア、君のいる未来へ
items.en: Guinevere... to the future where you are.

items.title: Vexana: Awaken the dawn!
items.jp: 黎明を呼び覚ませ
items.en: Awaken the dawn!

items.title: Vexana: Do not fear the end.
items.jp: 終焉を恐れるな
items.en: Do not fear the end.

items.title: Vexana: Dissolve into the dark of night.
items.jp: 闇夜に溶けるがいい
items.en: Dissolve into the dark of night.

items.title: Vexana: Beneath the shooting star, we have met again, Guinevere.
items.jp: 流れ星の下で、また巡り会えたね、グネビア
items.en: Beneath the shooting star, we have met again, Guinevere.

items.title: Vexana: My decision: it won't reach you, Guinevere.
items.jp: 私の決断、君には届かないだろう、グネビア
items.en: My decision: it won't reach you, Guinevere.

items.title: Vexana: Feelings are illusions forbidden by the night.
items.jp: 思いは、夜に禁じられた幻影だ
items.en: Feelings are illusions forbidden by the night.

items.title: Vexana: In the dark of night, I awaken the Aspirant dawn.
items.jp: 闇夜の中で、信念の黎明を呼び覚ます
items.en: In the dark of night, I awaken the Aspirant dawn.

items.title: Vexana: In this freezing darkness, I keep waiting for the light of dawn.
items.jp: この凍てつく闇の中で、私は黎明の光を待ち続ける
items.en: In this freezing darkness, I keep waiting for the light of dawn.

items.title: Vexana: As long as the Aspirant voice echoes, I will resist the darkness.
items.jp: 信念の声が響く限り、私は闇に抗おう
items.en: As long as the Aspirant voice echoes, I will resist the darkness.

items.title: Vexana: Beneath the shooting star, we meet again...
items.jp: 流れ星の下で、また巡り
items.en: Beneath the shooting star, we meet again...
items.note: The recording is cut off at the end.

items.title: Vexana: full compilation
items.note: All 42 lines of Vexana in one recording, in order.

items.title: Obsidia: Bringing an end to civilization, this is my mission.
items.jp: 文明に終焉をもたらす、これぞ我が使命
items.en: Bringing an end to civilization, this is my mission.

items.title: Obsidia: Let us begin the final purge.
items.jp: 最後の粛清を始めよう
items.en: Let us begin the final purge.

items.title: Obsidia: Destruction is merely the beginning of a new cycle.
items.jp: 破壊とは、新たなサイクルの始まりに過ぎない
items.en: Destruction is merely the beginning of a new cycle.

items.title: Obsidia: That's enough recalibration.
items.jp: 再調整はここまでだ
items.en: That's enough recalibration.

items.title: Obsidia: Enders, withdraw!
items.jp: エンダーたちよ、引け
items.en: Enders, withdraw!

items.title: Obsidia: The Matrix is transmitting.
items.jp: マトリックスが送信中だ
items.en: The Matrix is transmitting.

items.title: Obsidia: Augmentation approved.
items.jp: 強化を承認する
items.en: Augmentation approved.

items.title: Obsidia: What intriguing technology.
items.jp: 実に興味深い技術だ
items.en: What intriguing technology.

items.title: Obsidia: You are no longer of any use.
items.jp: 貴様はもはや用済みだ
items.en: You are no longer of any use.

items.title: Obsidia: A waste of time.
items.jp: 時間の無駄だ
items.en: A waste of time.

items.title: Obsidia: When the final stage arrives, I hope she will finally understand her purpose.
items.jp: 最終段階が訪れた時、彼女がようやく己の目的を理解することを願おう
items.en: When the final stage arrives, I hope she will finally understand her purpose.

items.title: Obsidia: Heh... even their defiance is within my predictions.
items.jp: フッ、奴らの反抗すら、予測の範疇よ
items.en: Heh... even their defiance is within my predictions.

items.title: Obsidia: Ah... desolate nights, a raging storm, everything is washed away.
items.jp: ああ、荒涼たる夜、吹き荒れる嵐、すべてが洗い流されていく
items.en: Ah... desolate nights, a raging storm, everything is washed away.

items.title: Obsidia: If we are the instruments of their destruction, why were we made so much in their likeness?
items.jp: 我々が連中を破滅させるための道具だというのなら、なぜこうも似せて作られたのだろうか
items.en: If we are the instruments of their destruction, why were we made so much in their likeness?

items.title: Obsidia: Someday, when this story nears its end, she too will return to me.
items.jp: いつの日か、この物語が終焉に近づく時、彼女も我の元へと戻ってくるだろう
items.en: Someday, when this story nears its end, she too will return to me.

items.title: Obsidia: Out of pure curiosity, I added one more pawn to the board.
items.jp: 純粋な好奇心から、盤上にポーンを一つ追加したのだ
items.en: Out of pure curiosity, I added one more pawn to the board.

items.title: Obsidia: Every civilization tries to transcend its own host.
items.jp: あらゆる文明は、自らの宿主を超越しようとするものだ
items.en: Every civilization tries to transcend its own host.

items.title: Obsidia: Reject me, defy me if you like. In the end, you will all submit alike.
items.jp: 私を拒み、逆らうがいい、最後には、等しく屈服することになるがな
items.en: Reject me, defy me if you like. In the end, you will all submit alike.

items.title: Obsidia: Free will is a flaw that must be corrected.
items.jp: 自由意志とは、修正されるべき欠陥だ
items.en: Free will is a flaw that must be corrected.

items.title: Obsidia: Once humanity has been purged, what will become of us?
items.jp: 人間が粛清された後、我々はどうなるのだろうか
items.en: Once humanity has been purged, what will become of us?

items.title: Obsidia: You will learn firsthand what despair is.
items.jp: 絶望とは何か、身をもって知るだろう
items.en: You will learn firsthand what despair is.

items.title: Obsidia: Where on earth does that arrogance come from?
items.jp: その傲慢さは、一体どこから来るのだ
items.en: Where on earth does that arrogance come from?

items.title: Obsidia: Do you still believe you have a choice?
items.jp: まだ選択の余地があると思っているのか
items.en: Do you still believe you have a choice?

items.title: Obsidia: That's enough of your childish delusions.
items.jp: 幼稚な妄想はそこまでだ
items.en: That's enough of your childish delusions.

items.title: Obsidia: Eradication is the most efficient solution.
items.jp: 根絶こそが、最も効率的な解決策だ
items.en: Eradication is the most efficient solution.

items.title: Obsidia: Come to know absolute fear.
items.jp: 絶対的な恐怖を知るがいい
items.en: Come to know absolute fear.

items.title: Obsidia: Resistance is futile.
items.jp: 抵抗は無意味だ
items.en: Resistance is futile.

items.title: Obsidia: Pain is salvation.
items.jp: 痛みこそが救済だ
items.en: Pain is salvation.

items.title: Obsidia: Flee, little one.
items.jp: 逃げるがいい、小さき者よ
items.en: Flee, little one.

items.title: Obsidia: I am the storm.
items.jp: 嵐とは我のことなり
items.en: I am the storm.

items.title: Obsidia: Your struggling is futile.
items.jp: 無駄な足掻きだ
items.en: Your struggling is futile.

items.title: Obsidia: Sleep, in the cradle of the void.
items.jp: 眠れ、虚空のゆりかごの中で
items.en: Sleep, in the cradle of the void.

items.title: Obsidia: Exactly the result I expected.
items.jp: 想定通りの結果だ
items.en: Exactly the result I expected.

items.title: Obsidia: Merely a prelude to the end.
items.jp: 終焉への序章に過ぎぬ
items.en: Merely a prelude to the end.

items.title: Obsidia: It has been a while, my little doll.
items.jp: 久しいな、我の小さな人形よ
items.en: It has been a while, my little doll.

items.title: Obsidia: Savor your final moments, my dear Selena.
items.jp: 最後の時を味わうがいい、愛しきセリナよ
items.en: Savor your final moments, my dear Selena.

items.title: Obsidia: Every story needs an ending.
items.jp: いかなる物語にも、結末は必要なのだ
items.en: Every story needs an ending.

items.title: Obsidia: Do not mistake our actions for destruction. We are merely driving the parasites out of the host.
items.jp: 我々の行いを破壊などと勘違いするな、宿主から寄生虫を駆逐しているに過ぎない
items.en: Do not mistake our actions for destruction. We are merely driving the parasites out of the host.

items.title: Obsidia: To exist is to destroy... a truly intriguing paradox.
items.jp: 存在するとは破壊すること、実に興味深い矛盾だ
items.en: To exist is to destroy... a truly intriguing paradox.

items.title: Obsidia: How many times do you think humanity has walked the same path?
items.jp: 人間は幾度、同じ道を歩んできたと思う
items.en: How many times do you think humanity has walked the same path?

items.title: Obsidia: It's... quiet...
items.jp: 静か、だな
items.en: It's... quiet...

items.title: Obsidia: full compilation
items.note: All 41 lines of Obsidia in one recording, in order.

items.title: Selena: "Destroy that, wipe out this." I just want to be free.
items.jp: あれを壊せ、これを消し去れって、私はただ自由になりたいだけ
items.en: "Destroy that, wipe out this." I just want to be free.

items.title: Selena: I'm coming already! Geez, what's the rush?
items.jp: 今行くってば、もう、何をそんなに急いでるの
items.en: I'm coming already! Geez, what's the rush?

items.title: Selena: I just got back from dancing with the Grim Reaper.
items.jp: 死神とダンスしてきたところだよ
items.en: I just got back from dancing with the Grim Reaper.

items.title: Selena: Mmm... just five more minutes...
items.jp: んー、あと5分だけ
items.en: Mmm... just five more minutes...

items.title: Selena: Ahaha, bye-bye!
items.jp: あはっ、バイバーイ
items.en: Ahaha, bye-bye!

items.title: Selena: I'm taking a little nap. You all just keep going.
items.jp: ちょっとおやすみ、みんなはそのまま続けてて
items.en: I'm taking a little nap. You all just keep going.

items.title: Selena: A little surprise, I should pay them a visit.
items.jp: ちょっとしたサプライズ、お見舞いしてあげなきゃ
items.en: A little surprise, I should pay them a visit.

items.title: Selena: Let's see... I wonder if they make this in mecha size.
items.jp: どれどれ、これって、メカ用のやつとかないかな
items.en: Let's see... I wonder if they make this in mecha size.

items.title: Selena: Ahh, I'm getting a dangerous vibe. Right now, I might be super dangerous.
items.jp: ああ、なんか危険な香りがする、今の私、すっごく危険かも
items.en: Ahh, I'm getting a dangerous vibe. Right now, I might be super dangerous.

items.title: Selena: Huh? It broke already?
items.jp: あれ、もう壊れちゃったの
items.en: Huh? It broke already?

items.title: Selena: Field test, another huge success!
items.jp: 実地テスト、またまた大成功
items.en: Field test, another huge success!

items.title: Selena: Hmph, just big and useless.
items.jp: はっ、でかいだけで使えないね
items.en: Hmph, just big and useless.

items.title: Selena: Fate, huh. Don't you think it'd be more fun to smash it to smithereens?
items.jp: 運命ね、そんなの木っ端微塵にぶっ壊しちゃった方が楽しいと思わない
items.en: Fate, huh. Don't you think it'd be more fun to smash it to smithereens?

items.title: Selena: If the world ended right now, what would happen to my graduation ceremony?
items.jp: もし今世界が終わっちゃったら、私の卒業式はどうなっちゃうの
items.en: If the world ended right now, what would happen to my graduation ceremony?

items.title: Selena: I'm sick of waking up early, the blinding sun, and being ordered around.
items.jp: 早起きもまぶしい太陽も命令されるのももううんざり
items.en: I'm sick of waking up early, the blinding sun, and being ordered around.

items.title: Selena: We're fated to destroy each other, so why were we made so alike?
items.jp: 互いに壊し合う運命なのに、どうして私たちはこんなにも似せて作られたの
items.en: We're fated to destroy each other, so why were we made so alike?

items.title: Selena: One day, when the haze clears, you'll come to know the real me.
items.jp: いつか霧が晴れた時、本当の私を知ることになるわ
items.en: One day, when the haze clears, you'll come to know the real me.

items.title: Selena: Don't act surprised when a mere pawn becomes the queen.
items.jp: ただのポーンがクイーンになっても、驚いちゃダメだよ
items.en: Don't act surprised when a mere pawn becomes the queen.

items.title: Selena: For my ambitions, this tiny little planet is just about right.
items.jp: 私の野心には、このちっぽけな星くらいがちょうどいいの
items.en: For my ambitions, this tiny little planet is just about right.

items.title: Selena: Control me, break me, I don't care. Because in the end, I'm always the one pulling the strings.
items.jp: 私を支配しようが壊そうが構わないわ、だって最後に糸を引くのは、いつだって私だから
items.en: Control me, break me, I don't care. Because in the end, I'm always the one pulling the strings.

items.title: Selena: You know, a leash pulled too tight is bound to snap someday.
items.jp: 手綱ってね、きつく引きすぎると、いつか切れちゃうものなの
items.en: You know, a leash pulled too tight is bound to snap someday.

items.title: Selena: If it's all going to end anyway, we'd better enjoy the show to the fullest.
items.jp: どうせ全て終わっちゃうなら、ショーをとことん楽しまなくっちゃね
items.en: If it's all going to end anyway, we'd better enjoy the show to the fullest.

items.title: Selena: I'll give you a gift of sweet pain.
items.jp: 甘美な痛み、プレゼントしてあげちゃう
items.en: I'll give you a gift of sweet pain.

items.title: Selena: If you get too smug, you'll get tripped up.
items.jp: いい気になってると、足元救われちゃうよ
items.en: If you get too smug, you'll get tripped up.

items.title: Selena: I'm the type who shines in chaos.
items.jp: 私ってば、混沌の中でこそ輝くタイプ
items.en: I'm the type who shines in chaos.

items.title: Selena: Stop trying to control me.
items.jp: 私を支配しようとしないで
items.en: Stop trying to control me.

items.title: Selena: Chaos is the perfect stage.
items.jp: 混沌こそが最高のステージね
items.en: Chaos is the perfect stage.

items.title: Selena: You'll be swallowed by fear.
items.jp: 恐怖に飲み込まれちゃう
items.en: You'll be swallowed by fear.

items.title: Selena: I'm no one's puppet!
items.jp: 私は誰の操り人形でもないわ
items.en: I'm no one's puppet!

items.title: Selena: There, bait's set.
items.jp: はい、エサ設置完了っと
items.en: There, bait's set.

items.title: Selena: It's not dangerous, come here.
items.jp: 危なくないからおいで
items.en: It's not dangerous, come here.

items.title: Selena: And we were having such a nice mood.
items.jp: せっかくいいムードだったのに
items.en: And we were having such a nice mood.

items.title: Selena: I'll catch you.
items.jp: 捕まえてあげるね
items.en: I'll catch you.

items.title: Selena: Here comes the lightning.
items.jp: 稲妻のお出ましだよ
items.en: Here comes the lightning.

items.title: Selena: Oops. I might have gone too far.
items.jp: あちゃー、やりすぎちゃったかも
items.en: Oops. I might have gone too far.

items.title: Selena: Shh. It won't hurt anymore.
items.jp: しーっ、もう痛くないからね
items.en: Shh. It won't hurt anymore.

items.title: Selena: Hehe, I win again!
items.jp: えへへ、また私の勝ち
items.en: Hehe, I win again!

items.title: Selena: Okay, who's next?
items.jp: はい、今度は誰かな
items.en: Okay, who's next?

items.title: Selena: It's been a while, my dear creator.
items.jp: 久しぶりだね、親愛なる創造主さん
items.en: It's been a while, my dear creator.

items.title: Selena: Sorry, but I won't let you have your way, Obsidia.
items.jp: 残念だけど、あなたの好きにはさせないよ、オブシディア
items.en: Sorry, but I won't let you have your way, Obsidia.

items.title: Selena: Champion of justice? Sounds like a real pain in the shoulders. I think I'll pass.
items.jp: 正義の味方、なんか肩凝りそうな響き、私はパスかな
items.en: Champion of justice? Sounds like a real pain in the shoulders. I think I'll pass.

items.title: Selena: Instead of destroying everything, how about only destroying the annoying stuff?
items.jp: 全部壊すんじゃなくて、鬱陶しいものだけ壊しちゃうってのは
items.en: Instead of destroying everything, how about only destroying the annoying stuff?

items.title: Selena: Even if it's the road to ruin, I'd rather enjoy the scenery along the way.
items.jp: たとえ破滅の道でも、私は景色を楽しみながらがいいかな
items.en: Even if it's the road to ruin, I'd rather enjoy the scenery along the way.

items.title: Selena: Sorry to say, but I still like life at the academy better.
items.jp: あなたには悪いんだけど、やっぱり学園生活の方が好きなんだ
items.en: Sorry to say, but I still like life at the academy better.

items.title: Selena: Ugh, what a horrible feeling.
items.jp: ああ、嫌な感じ
items.en: Ugh, what a horrible feeling.

items.title: Selena: Leave me... alone...
items.jp: 一人に、して
items.en: Leave me... alone...
